sync.description: git pull --ff-only in the WSL checkout of mimir.

gpu-status.description: nvidia-smi summary, the running mimir job, and whether the GPU is free (VRAM in use vs a threshold).

run.description: run <job>: start infra/gaming-pc/jobs/<job>.sh detached, logging to runs/_gaming-pc/logs/<job>.log. Refuses if the GPU is busy or a job is running. A stopped job resumes.

job-status.description: job-status [job]: whether the job runs, its latest checkpoint, DONE marker and the end of its log.

stop.description: Stop the running job gracefully (SIGTERM: it checkpoints, then exits; killed after 10 min). Use this, not stop_job.

push-results.description: push-results [job]: commit small result files from runs/<job>/ to results/gaming-pc/ on the branch gaming-pc-results and push it.
